verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. Jira can view development status, integrate with Bitbucket, and use automation to keep Jira up to date (one-way), and it offers Trello sync, but Trello is not a code-repository issue tracker. Nothing documents first-party bi-directional sync of tasks with a repository's issue tracker. Marketplace third-party apps and REST APIs are building blocks or external add-ons, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
